system.description: Your target loses a finger. This hand will suffer a -2 penalty on all checks until appropriate healing spell cast upon the target.
"...nothing more. Who's your friend?" You utter those words and the first party member to call out a target gets to choose who gets a bonus attack. Apply [[1d10]] damage to that target.

Your target's lung is slashed. This results in the target being stunned for 2 rounds with a -1 penalty to combat until healed with appropriate healing spell. If this action is impossible due to the nature of the target, then you do standard critical damage +5, instead.
Off in the distance you hear lute music. It is quickly getting closer and louder. Out of nowhere comes a lute, smacking the target in the head doing [[1d10]] bludgeoning damage.
Your target is "blinded" until the end of its next turn.
You feel the admiration of your party and it fills your heart. Roll a [[1d6]] and add that number in temporary hit points to your character.
Your target is "dazed" until the end of its next turn.

A catchy tune enters your target's mind. They are paralyzed for [[1d4]] rounds as their OCD forces them to sing the entire song in their head. You can hear them humming it, but they are otherwise motionless. Hum the tune you hear to your party.
The target takes ongoing 5 +1/2 your level damage (round up).
You hamstring the target. While they don't fall prone, the target is "slowed" a DC8 DEX ends it.

The target loses [[1d6]] bludgeoning for a blow to the skull. They are dazed and permanently grant combat advantage to opponents approaching from whichever side was hit. If this action is impossible due to the nature of the target you do standard critical hit damage +10, instead.

Your hit dazzles your party... but which is the most dazzled party member? Each of them must compliment your hit — choose the best one. They were inspired by you, so they draw a card from the inspiration deck.
That was pretty bad-ass. Draw a card from the inspiration deck — it goes straight into your inventory, to play whenever you like.

Your target is "turned" for 1 minute or until attacked. It must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't willingly move to a space within 30 feet of you. For its Action, it can use only the Dash Action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving.

Your target's leg is cut off at the knee, and movement reduced to 1/4 speed. Target will have a permanent limp and -5 movement as an after affect. If this action is impossible due to the nature of the target then you do standard critical damage [[1d8]], instead. You point at your leg and wink at the target.
You knock the target prone. "Ouch," it thinks, "I am suddenly having a pretty bad day."
You knock the target Unconcious. A DC10 Intelligence check or target taking damage ends.
You do twice the critical hit damage to the target.
You get a bonus action to try to grapple your target if you choose to do so.
You may take an extra standard action this turn.
You gain +2 to all your defenses against attacks from the target until the end of your next turn.
Your target pulls out a mug of ale to dull the pain and finds themselves intoxicated for the next [[1d4]] rounds..
The party attacks with advantage until the end of the round. If you are the last member of the party in the round, well, better luck next time.
You hit your target hard... real hard. It poops its pants. Your target is stunned until the end of the next round.
You got on their nerves, so the target is "weakened." A DC 11 Strength ends it.
Your target is charmed. It remains so until it is attacked, you release it, or it makes a DC10 Wisdom saving throw.
You roll 2d6 and change the initiative of the target of your choice to [[2d6]]. Do this [[1d6]] times and shout, "Restack, mofo!" each time.
The target moves 50 feet (or until they hit a wall or object) in the direction of your choosing. They take [[1d6]] bludgeoning damage.
A mysterious force surrounds you. For the next [[1d4]] rounds attacks against you are -2 to hit.

Your target's arm is severed at the shoulder and is "stunned" for 2 rounds. This results in a permanent -2 to all checks until healed with appropriate healing spell. If this action is impossible due to the nature of the target, you do standard critical hit damage +7, instead.
Your target can only move half its distance and attacks with disadvantage for the next two rounds.
You regain a spell slot or can gift the same to one of your party members.
Your target attacks itself with its primary weapon.
Your target is "stunned" until the end of its next turn.

For a brief moment your target sees themselves in relation to the totality of the universe. You see a "You Are Here" sign flash above their head... after which they suffer [[2d6]] psychic damage and fall to their knees prone.
You gain combat advantage against all enemies on the battlefield until the end of your next turn.
The target is blind until the end of the next round

The target's hand is removed at the wrist. There is a 50% chance of either main or off hand... and if main hand, they now roll with disadvantage. Roll a d100 and if [[1d100]] is greater than 50, they lost the hand. If this action is not possible due to the nature of the target, then in addition to standard critical damage, you gain an inspiration point instead.

As you attacked your target, you had a childhood memory randomly pop into your head... a little companion from your past. Poof! Next to you appears that pet until your next long rest. Choose one of the following: cat, dog, pig, rabbit, or chicken. They have 5 HP and are your familiar for the day.
You pop a pipe in the mouth of your target... a novelty pipe. It explodes and does an additional [[1d6]] of damage to the target. You look them in the eye and say, "I learned this from watching you!"
